# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server log lines under the --save-turret client of
# mp_carentan-dm-turret-hitgrid.txt beside this file. Captured 2026-10-17.
# The -spawn recipe with probe_hitlog 1 and probe_hitgrid 1: every hit's
# point and direction to the float's last bit, and a 9 by 9 bulletTrace grid
# along the round inside the damage callback. map mp_carentan, g_gametype
# probe_turret, probe_teleport 1, probe_hitlog 1, probe_hitgrid 1, dedicated 1,
# sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, a homepath holding no pak. Client 0 is a
# --probe-team axis --probe-fall net-probe standing as the target, client 1
# the --save-turret gunner.
# 
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=32752 PROBE_SECS=230 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1 +set probe_hitlog 1 +set probe_hitgrid 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32752 --probe-team axis --probe-fall --probe-secs 200
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32752 --save-turret --capture-tag hitgrid --probe-secs 190
# The axis client started 10 s after the server and the gunner 5 s after it.
#
